images.title: Grow a square by one border
images.purpose: Shows the square builder's core move: a 4 by 4 square of 16 tiles grows to 5 by 5 by adding an L shaped border of 9 tiles.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One large tile square in the centre with its new border in a second colour and a small drag handle.
images.exact_structure: One 5 by 5 square of exactly 25 equal tiles. The top left 4 by 4 block of exactly 16 tiles is filled teal (#0072B2). The remaining exactly 9 tiles, the right column of 5 and the bottom row of 4 more, form an L shaped border filled amber (#E69F00). A small round reddish purple (#CC79A7) drag handle sits at the bottom right corner. To the left of the square: 4² = 16 next to the teal block. Beside the border: + 9. Below the square: 5² = 25. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: A square of side n holds n² tiles, and each step adds a border of the next odd number.
images.description: Shows the square builder's core move: a 4 by 4 square of 16 tiles grows to 5 by 5 by adding an L shaped border of 9 tiles.

image_decisions.why: The tool's core action is dragging the side and watching the area and the new border change.
